thread:
maya: Heads-up — noticing ~6% drop in prefix cache hit-rate for RAG routes since the kernel-selector deploy this morning. Dashboard: https://grafana.internal/d/prefix-cache
perf-bot: ALERT: prefix-cache-hitrate -6.1% for service/rag-serve (p95 latency +12ms). See /alerts/4332
igor: Which deploy rolled when? kernel-selector v2.4.0?
sasha: Yes, rolled v2.4.0 at 04:20 UTC. Canary looked clean for CPU, but we didn't run workload-specific cache replays.
kevin: Any changes to keying/normalization in that release?
igor: No explicit keying changes. We did prefer fused-attn kernel for >2k contexts; could affect how tokenizer normalization interacts with prefix hashing.
maya: Small profile paste (snippet):
```
[2026-03-18 04:23:07] kv_cache::lookup miss key=sha1:ab3f... path=prefix_norm len=72
[2026-03-18 04:23:07] prefix_norm::sanitize -> trimmed_trailing_newline=true
[2026-03-18 04:23:07] kv_cache::write key=sha1:cd4a... path=prefix_norm len=71
```
sasha: Interesting — we see miss then write with different keys (len off by 1). Could be tokenization variant removing a trailing newline in some code path.
kevin: I'll run a before/after key-diff on a sample of requests. Can someone point me to snapshots?
igor: Try s3://redwood-prod-snapshots/prefix-keys/2026-03-12 and s3://redwood-prod-snapshots/prefix-keys/2026-03-18.
maya: Quick grep on traces showed many instances where normalized prefix differs only by trailing whitespace. Example: "User: what's the owner?\n" vs "User: what's the owner?"
sasha: Also note the coalescer's batching change in v2.4.0 modifies request grouping; if prefetch order differs, eviction timing changes and hit-rate can drop even without key changes.
kevin: Running comparator: `./bin/prefix-hash-diff --before s3://snapshots/2026-03-12 --after s3://snapshots/2026-03-18 --sample 50k --out /tmp/prefix-diff.json` — will report mismatches by normalized-bytes.
maya: Perf trace link: https://traces.internal/t/abcd1234 — shows prefix-normalization executed in <1ms but mismatch rate higher post-deploy.
sasha: Action items:
- rollback the kernel-selector preferential-fused change in canary (igor)
- add normalization unit test across tokenizer variants (sasha)
- run offline cache replay with RAG + structured outputs + chat prefixes (kevin)
igor: Starting canary rollback now.
kevin: Kickstarted replay (50k RAG queries, mix of long-context and structured). ETA ~45m. Will post interim hit-rate heatmap.
maya: I'll add an alert to flag small normalized-bytes diffs causing cache key divergence. Also adding a short eval job in Optimize to detect these patterns.
sasha: Good. Keep updates in this thread. :white_check_mark:
